method: Verified that all 16 query arrays contain only zeros. Generated 2340 unseen sentence candidates by joining calibration prefixes and suffixes at shared spans. Ranked whole candidates using supporting calibration-pair counts and the empirical calibration word-count/duration distribution, smoothed with a fixed four-frame Gaussian bandwidth. No neural-to-word model or labeled neural prototypes were trained. Reproducible script: reconstruct_priors.py. Supporting examples, alternatives, and zero-array checks: reconstruction_evidence.json. Results: predictions.json.
limitations: Actual query words and order are unidentifiable from the withheld activity. These predictions are speculative calibration-prior guesses.
Recording duration does not establish word count, boundaries, identity, or order.
The splice heuristic favors frequent calibration patterns; its scores are not calibrated probabilities. Alphabetical ordering resolves ties.
Equal-length queries receive identical guesses because their available evidence is identical.
